title: Tanker owners' profit more than doubled. Now it's easing.
dek: Hormuz's closure lifted SCI's Q2 profit 3.1x and GE Shipping's 2.2x, though both earned less than in Q1; with its Fujairah terminal idle, JSW Infrastructure's profit fell 12%.

read: The owners' windfall follows Gulf headlines and is already easing; full big ports are the gain more likely to last. Watch Q3 tanker rates.

notes: Net profit growth from filed Q2 FY27 results (consolidated; GRSE standalone), with the change vs Q1 FY27 in each label. GE Shipping's Q1 record (₹1,309 cr) and its comment that product tanker and Aframax rates were significantly lower in Q2 come from its Q1 FY27 call; the desk's 'Q2 FY27' GE Shipping transcript is a 2021 call and was not used. SEAMEC (loss to ₹50 cr profit) is left out because a percentage change is not meaningful, and Allcargo Terminals because only standalone results are on the desk. Cochin Shipyard's profit fall reflects thin margins on its current order book, not the Gulf; shipyards are shown for contrast.
